name: the_first_kinds_mask_comes_from_the_wrong_pool_entry
subs: #define MASK_A    0x0c06bfacu   /* the mask for the first kind  (a halfword) */
#define MASK_A    0x0c06bfaeu   /* the mask for the first kind  (a halfword) */

name: the_second_kinds_mask_comes_from_the_wrong_pool_entry
subs: #define MASK_B    0x0c06bfaeu   /* the mask for the second kind (a halfword) */
#define MASK_B    0x0c06bfbcu   /* the mask for the second kind (a halfword) */

name: the_flags_pointer_comes_from_the_wrong_pool_entry
subs: #define FLAGS_PTR 0x0c06bfbcu   /* the word that points at the flags byte */
#define FLAGS_PTR 0x0c06bfc0u   /* the word that points at the flags byte */

name: the_table_pointer_comes_from_the_wrong_pool_entry
subs: #define TABLE_PTR 0x0c06bfc0u   /* the word that points at the table */
#define TABLE_PTR 0x0c06bfbcu   /* the word that points at the table */

name: the_delay_slot_does_not_advance_the_counter
subs: R(12) += 1u;                    /* the delay slot: it runs on both paths */
R(12) += 0u;                    /* the delay slot: it runs on both paths */

name: the_flags_are_not_masked_with_the_kinds_mask
subs: R(14) &= mask;              /* the delay slot of the branch */
R(14) &= 0xffffffffu;       /* the delay slot of the branch */

name: the_count_down_does_not_restart_the_counter
subs: R(7) = R(12);          /* the delay slot of the branch */
R(7) = 0u;             /* the delay slot of the branch */
